name: Longshore
summary: Murlocs command the surf at Longshore, where broken ships lie beneath the waves.

sections.title: A Treacherous Coastline
sections.body:
Along Westfall’s western coast, Longshore stretches wide with unbroken sand. Travelers find little peace here. Murlocs rule the surf, and Old Murk-Eye is among their feared leaders. Sunken ships, including ruined elven destroyers, lie in the shallows.

Near the south, Daphne Stilwell’s isolated farm faces Defias bandits. Across the water, you can see the Westfall Lighthouse.

faq.q: Why is the Longshore so dangerous?
aliases: why are there so many murlocs
faq.answer: Aggressive murloc tribes roam Longshore and ambush those who stray near the surf. Defias bandits also raid homesteads at the beach’s southern end.
Daphne Stilwell lives alone on a farm in southwestern Longshore. Defias Brotherhood raids threaten her, so the Knights of the Silver Hand send paladin initiates to defend her.

faq.q: What are the shipwrecks lying off the coast?
faq.answer: Merchant ships and elven destroyers lie among the wrecks submerged off Longshore, lost in past naval conflicts. Scavengers, murlocs, and adventurers seek relics among the underwater ruins.

faq.q: Why do druids visit the Longshore?
faq.answer: Alliance druids undertake the Trial of the Sea Lion to master their aquatic form. They must retrieve the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance from a submerged chest near a shipwreck off northwestern Longshore.

angles.text: As a paladin guided by Duthorian Rall in Stormwind, you are sent south to Daphne Stilwell’s homestead on Longshore. There, you prove your valor by protecting an innocent farmer from Defias raiders.
As an Alliance druid, you must brave the waters off northwestern Longshore and find a lockbox near a sunken wreck. Its contents help you assemble the pendant needed for your aquatic form.
